alerts.title: Notice
alerts.insufficientDrive: Insufficient pressure to drive flow. Increase the pressure.
alerts.lowFlow: Flow is too low to measure. Change the parameters.
alerts.insufficientFluid: There is not enough fluid in the left beaker for all the strokes. Refill or reduce the strokes.
alerts.noSourcePressure: Without pressure in the left beaker the pump cannot fill.
alerts.lowInflow: Flow into the pump is too low.
alerts.lowOutflow: Pump pressure must exceed the right beaker pressure for flow to occur.
alerts.rateTooHigh: The rate would exceed 999 strokes/min. Change the parameters.
